notes.title: [Update Announcement] April 3, 16:00
notes.notes:
[Update Announcement] April 3rd 16:00

Maintenance update content:
1. Warrior's assistant manufacturing abnormality
2. Two pathfinding errors in the client
3. In-game welfare link replacement
4. Some payment issues
5. Novice equipment changed to non-disassembled
6. Fixed the seven-day goal that cannot be completed in two people
7. Fixed the abnormal problem of team departure
8. Abnormal display of the task bar in the arena

Maintenance updates are based on actual time, please be patient!

notes.title: The demo will be shut down today and the official version will be launched soon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
       The demo experience of the new product festival of "Youxing Continent" will be officially ended at 10 am today and the files will be deleted and the server will be shut down. This trial will also be completed. At the same time, we will announce a new news for everyone. The official version will be launched in April, so stay tuned!

       In addition, we are preparing for the English translation, but in the end we can only complete some core translations, but we will continue to optimize.

        DEMO server closure and file deletion time: Today (March 14) at 10:00 am（CST）, the files will be deleted and the server will be shut down. At the same time, the store demo trial entrance will be closed, and players will no longer be able to start the game.


official website：https://yxdl.sydsj.cc
